note: Waterfront RV park in the Fort Myers Beach area with sites directly on San Carlos Bay.  --AWH  Two pets per site.  From December to April, boat, utility and car trailers must be stored off the property, and each site gets one vehicle.  Free Wi-Fi; electric is metered on monthly sites.  Check-in is at noon, check-out at 11 a.m. --Claude

min_stay.season: January to March, by the month only
Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day

booking.note: January to March, stays are by the month only; daily otherwise. A deposit holds a site but not a specific one.

booking.source: https://www.sancarlosrv.com/copy-of-home ('JAN/FEB/MARCH'; 'Holidays 3 night minimum'; 'Your deposit guarantees you a site, but we do not guarantee a specific site'), read 2026-10-14; AWH 2026-10-14: the winter daily rates are an image on the rates page, dated 2025-26 but still the prices for the 2026-27 winter: $75 for a Choice site up to $134 for an Ultimate site; one-month minimum January to March, daily otherwise
